was: Clothing-optional naturist park on the Oak Ridges Moraine off Kennedy Rd, ~30 min north of Toronto, open year-round to non-member visitors as well as members. Listed at about 200 sites with 120 hydro/water sites (20/30/50 amp), pull-throughs and a dump station, RVs accepted to 44 ft. Short-term camping is rustic $11.50/night or 2-service (water + 120V 30-amp) $23.89/night, plus a daily grounds fee (about $52 CAD for a family/couple/single); HST extra. Clubhouse with sauna and whirlpool, pool, on-site pond and beach, trails, laundry, store. Reservable online. --Claude

was: Large gated resort park on Musselman's Lake at Ballantrae, under an hour from Toronto. 560 sites: 480 full-season trailer sites plus a distinct block of about 80 overnight RV sites, so nightly transient camping is real inventory rather than a token handful - but expect a heavily seasonal park with permanent trailers on most pads. Site services: 509 with electric/water/sewer, 41 electric/water, 10 unserviced; 50-amp available. Private two-tier beach, two pools, hot tub, splash pad, tennis and basketball courts, general store and a patio restaurant on the lake; boat/kayak/paddleboat rentals. Open Apr 1 - Oct 31; overnight sites bookable online through CampLife or by phone. --Claude

was: Private park on Witmer Rd at Petersburg, just west of Kitchener. 245 sites, all with electric/water/sewer, 30 amp max, RV max length 42 ft; 224 are full-season and 21 are dedicated overnight RV sites (plus 2 rental units) — a seasonal-heavy park but with a real transient loop, shown in pink on the park map. Open April 24 - November 1; reservable online through CampLife or by phone. Overnight rate $70 CAD (off-season) to $85 CAD (peak, May 29 - Sept 6) plus HST. Mature trees, creek, several ponds, heated pool and swimming pond on site. --Claude

was: Private 150-acre park on the Bonnechere River at Killaloe (between Round Lake and Golden Lake), west of Pembroke. 100 trailer sites — 89 full-season, 10 overnight RV sites and 1 overnight tent site — plus 3 rental cottages; 89 sites with electric/water/sewer, 6 electric+water, 5 unserviced, 30 amp max, RV max length 44 ft. Seasonal-heavy but keeps a dedicated overnight section with published nightly rates ($40-55 CAD). Open May 1 - October 30; reservable online (CampLife) or by phone. Beach, docks and boat access to both lakes. --Claude

was: Family-owned 250-acre park wrapped around private spring-fed Clam Lake east of Kincardine. 38 overnight RV sites and 4 overnight tent sites alongside ~516 seasonal sites and 12 camping cabins; 548 sites with hydro/water/sewer and 10 hydro+water, 50-amp and pull-thru sites, RVs to 45 ft. Groomed sand beach, boat launch, fishing dock, two indoor pools. Open ~May 1-Oct 1; overnight sites reservable online. --Claude

was: 300-acre family campground on Centre Rd between London and Grand Bend with 212 mature shaded sites, 35 x 75 ft, serviced (water + 15/30-amp) or unserviced, easily taking large RVs. Open Apr 29-Oct 10; overnight rates ~$45 unserviced / $60 serviced, reservable online (walk-ins accepted with a deposit). --Claude

was: Park on Beaver Creek Road in north Waterloo, ~15 min from Hwy 401 and an hour from Toronto. 95 overnight sites plus ~250 seasonal; fully serviced back-in and pull-thru sites with 30/50-amp, water and sewer, dump station, RV storage, pool, playground, laundry and Wi-Fi. Open Mar 1-Dec 31, a long shoulder season for the region; overnight rates ~$38-49 (2-night minimum on weekends, 3 on long weekends). Reservable online. --Claude

was: Large 407-site family resort at 2325 Regional Road 24 (Victoria Ave) between Vineland and Fenwick in Niagara. Mostly seasonal but runs a real transient program with online booking: 2026 nightly rates $50-$65 non-serviced, $55-$70 electric/water, $60-$75 full-hookup back-in (phone booking) and $65-$85 full-hookup pull-thru CAD, rate covering four people. No dump station on site and the electric/water sites have no sewer. Two pools, splash pad, basketball and tennis courts, on-site water for fishing and paddleboarding. Open May 1 to Oct 16; 3-night minimum on holiday weekends. --Claude

was: Family-run since 1970 at 877 Main St, about 1.5 km inland from the Sauble Beach strip on Lake Huron. Operator site states 300 sites for seasonal and overnight camping, of which 100 are short-term camping sites, some with water, electricity and sewer, and drive-thru sites are available; also 14-21 rental trailers, indoor and outdoor pools, rec hall, laundry, propane. Season roughly May 1 - mid-October. Reservable online through CampLife or by phone. Caveat: the operator's own domain has an expired TLS certificate and stale blog posts, though the CampLife booking channel and current directory listings show it operating. --Claude

was: Long-running family park (in operation over 90 years) on the east shore of Little Lake in Midland, minutes from town. 147 sites split between a fully-booked seasonal section and an overnight section; the operator's site map shows numbered loops on Stan's Circle, Minnow/Catfish/Perch/Bass Drives and Lakeshore Road with 30-amp and 50-amp electric, water and sewer, paved roads and gravel pads, plus pull-thrus. No tent camping. Beach on Little Lake, pool, store, propane, laundry, playground. Overnight season runs mid-May to October; reservations through CampLife. A separate mobile-home park adjoins the campground at the office end. --Claude

was: Private 72-acre campground in East Richer, ~50 km east of Winnipeg on Hwy 1 at Thurston Rd. Mix of seasonal and overnight/transient sites (nightly, weekly and monthly rates); full-service plus electric/water sites, dump station, flush toilets, showers, laundry, WiFi, playground, and a man-made swim pond (KaMaKi Beach). Open May 1 to Oct 31; reservable online via CampLife or by phone. Satellite shows rows of RV/trailer pads carved into trees around a central beach pond. --Claude
